item.title: 🎃 Halloween: The Game — New Post
item.dc:creator: @HalloweenTVG
item.description:
Halloween: The Game (@HalloweenTVG)

Patch 1.3.0 Delay

The development team discovered a critical crash stemming from our engine upgrade to Unreal 5.8.

While we are sorry to delay the patch, we have a commitment to quality for our gaming community. To ensure the best possible experience, our team needs more time to investigate potential issues related to this engine upgrade.

Thank you for your support, and we will provide updates here as they become available.
